stations.title: Idris
stations.say: One word for my four lines?

stations.title: Sol's count.sh
stations.text: Counts one day only, and always says yes.

stations.title: Idris
stations.say: One word, and I can trust it.

captions: At Ashgrove, Idris types the same four lines every evening and wants one word instead.
Today each line is typed by hand, and Sol's counter always says it worked.
You write your first scripts, make them run and hand them files, in four small tasks.
One command runs the evening's lines, and the counter counts any day it is given.
Idris types one word each evening, and a failed count now says that it failed.
